raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`QuarkW4A4MXFp4MoE` imports its AITER shuffle helpers only when `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` but always calls them after loading, so outside `docker/rocm.Dockerfile` (the only place that sets it) every Quark MXFP4 MoE checkpoint fails with `NameError: name 'e8m0_shuffle' is not defined`; this PR binds those helpers and the matching weight layout on gfx95 and gfx1250 regardless of the env var.

`process_weights_after_loading` calls `e8m0_shuffle` on gfx950 and `moe_shuffle_scale`/`moe_shuffle_weight` on gfx1250. The scheme has no other path, since `create_moe_runner` accepts only the AITER runner. The failure also hits `--quantization quark_mxfp4`, which `test/registered/e2e/quantization/test_quark_mxfp4.py` launches without the env var.

## Modifications

- On gfx95 and gfx1250, `_use_aiter` in `quark_w4a4_mxfp4_moe.py` no longer depends on `SGLANG_USE_AITER`. This binds the imports together with the weight layout (`_is_shuffle_moe_mxfp4`, AITER padding). Other HIP arches still follow the env var, because AITER defines no FP4 MoE layout for them; #41389 handles gfx1151.
- Binding only the imports, as #31805 does, is not enough: the weights stay unshuffled and AITER falls back from the FlyDSL kernels to CK 2-stage, which is 23–37 % slower at M ≥ 257.
- With `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` the expression evaluates the same, so the weights handed to the MoE kernel are byte-identical to main's.
- `TestQuarkMxfp4MoEShuffleImports` reloads the module without the env var for gfx95, gfx1250 and other HIP arches. main fails the gfx95 and gfx1250 cases.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X, TP1, `SGLANG_USE_AITER` unset unless noted:

| model | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen3.5-35B-A3B `--quantization quark_mxfp4`, real weights | NameError | GSM8K 0.820 (200 q, 5-shot) |
| same, main with `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` (reference) | GSM8K 0.835 | — |
| Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, MiniMax-M3, Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2 (MXFP4, dummy weights, 8 layers) | NameError | loads and serves |

The 0.015 gap is within the ±0.027 standard error at 200 questions. With the env var unset, attention and top-k also leave AITER, so the two arms differ outside the MoE as well.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MoE layer at Qwen3.5-397B shapes, median of 3 warm runs per arm:

| M | main, env=1 (µs) | this PR, env unset (µs) | Δ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 237.1 | 235.9 | −0.5 % |
| 33 | 420.6 | 420.4 | −0.0 % |
| 257 | 733.4 | 731.4 | −0.3 % |
| 1029 | 826.2 | 823.5 | −0.3 % |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

---

@@ -44,8 +44,12 @@
 __all__ = ["QuarkW4A4MXFp4MoE"]
 
 _is_hip = is_hip()
-_use_aiter = get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_USE_AITER") and _is_hip
 _is_gfx95 = is_gfx95_supported()
+# This scheme runs only on the AITER runner, so on the arches AITER has an MXFP4
+# MoE layout for, that layout is bound whatever SGLANG_USE_AITER says.
+_use_aiter = _is_hip and (
+    get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_USE_AITER") or _is_gfx95 or is_gfx1250_supported()
+)
 _is_shuffle_moe_mxfp4 = _use_aiter and _is_gfx95
 _aiter_k3_opt = _use_aiter and get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT")
 if _use_aiter:

@@ -4,6 +4,8 @@
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=11, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
+import importlib
+import os
 import sys
 import types
 import unittest
@@ -457,6 +459,73 @@ def test_fused_wqkv_a_takes_the_wq_a_block_fp8_spec(self):
         self.assertIsInstance(method, Fp8LinearMethod)
 
 
+def _stub(*args, **kwargs):
+    return None
+
+
+def _fake_aiter_shuffle_modules():
+    """The aiter modules the scheme imports at load, so this stays a CPU test."""
+    shuffle = types.ModuleType("aiter.ops.shuffle")
+    for name in (
+        "moe_shuffle_scale",
+        "moe_shuffle_weight",
+        "shuffle_scale_a16w4",
+        "shuffle_weight",
+        "shuffle_weight_a16w4",
+    ):
+        setattr(shuffle, name, _stub)
+    fp4_utils = types.ModuleType("aiter.utility.fp4_utils")
+    fp4_utils.e8m0_shuffle = _stub
+    triton_quant = types.ModuleType("aiter.ops.triton.quant")
+    triton_quant.dynamic_mxfp4_quant = _stub
+    return {
+        "aiter.ops.shuffle": shuffle,
+        "aiter.utility.fp4_utils": fp4_utils,
+        "aiter.ops.triton.quant": triton_quant,
+    }
+
+
+class TestQuarkMxfp4MoEShuffleImports(CustomTestCase):
+    """process_weights_after_loading's shuffle helpers must be bound wherever it
+    calls them, whatever SGLANG_USE_AITER says: e8m0_shuffle() on gfx95 and
+    moe_shuffle_scale()/moe_shuffle_weight() on gfx1250."""
+
+    def _reload_without_env(self, *, is_gfx95, is_gfx1250):
+        previous = os.environ.pop("SGLANG_USE_AITER", None)
+        try:
+            with (
+                patch.dict(sys.modules, _fake_aiter_shuffle_modules()),
+                patch("sglang.srt.utils.is_hip", lambda: True),
+                patch("sglang.srt.utils.is_gfx95_supported", lambda: is_gfx95),
+                patch("sglang.srt.utils.is_gfx1250_supported", lambda: is_gfx1250),
+            ):
+                return importlib.reload(quark_moe)
+        finally:
+            if previous is not None:
+                os.environ["SGLANG_USE_AITER"] = previous
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        importlib.reload(quark_moe)
+
+    def test_gfx95_binds_the_scale_and_weight_shuffles(self):
+        reloaded = self._reload_without_env(is_gfx95=True, is_gfx1250=False)
+
+        self.assertTrue(reloaded._is_shuffle_moe_mxfp4)
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(reloaded, "e8m0_shuffle"))
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(reloaded, "shuffle_weight"))
+
+    def test_gfx1250_binds_the_n32k4_shuffles(self):
+        reloaded = self._reload_without_env(is_gfx95=False, is_gfx1250=True)
+
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(reloaded, "moe_shuffle_scale"))
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(reloaded, "moe_shuffle_weight"))
+
+    def test_other_hip_arches_still_follow_the_env_var(self):
+        reloaded = self._reload_without_env(is_gfx95=False, is_gfx1250=False)
+
+        self.assertFalse(reloaded._use_aiter)
+
+
 class _Runner:
     """Records the quant_info apply_weights() hands to the runner."""
